name: Gearbox
text: Switch to the NVIDIA H100 with Llama 3.4 70B. It’s the only option that’s both proven in production and backward-compatible with EXCAVA’s current stack. The trade-off is higher upfront cost, but the 12% speed gain over the Cerebras CS-3 justifies it by cutting iteration time.

name: Torque
text: The claim of a 12% speed gain with the H100 and Llama 3.4 70B ignores potential bottlenecks in integration or compatibility with EXCAVA’s existing workflows. The higher upfront cost may not yield a quick return on investment if adaptation issues arise or if training times offset speed gains. A more prudent alternative would be to evaluate newer or less-costly models that maintain compatibility, which reduces financial risk and provides flexibility while still aiming for that incremental performance boost. Validation through a pilot test would clarify the actual performance impact before committing to the H100.
